fullPassage: It’s important for humans to have many kinds of minds, because variation is critical for the survival of a species. One of Charles Darwin’s greatest insights was that variation is a prerequisite for natural selection to work. Think about it: If there’s a huge change in the environment, like a catastrophic drop in the food supply or a big increase in temperature, a species without much variation might be completely wiped out. A species with great variation will more likely have some survivors after any catastrophe ― the members who are well suited for the new environment. Darwin observed variation in the bodies of animals, and the same principle applies to human minds. If we all had the same kind of mind ― if there were only one human nature ― then when disaster struck, we might become extinct. Thankfully, our species has many kinds of minds, both within a single culture and across cultures, so we’re less likely to be wiped out. This variation preserves the evolvability of our species.

det.korean: wiped out은 '완전히 없어지다', 즉 종이 멸종한다는 의미이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 완전히 사라지다(멸종): 변이가 없는 종이 큰 환경 변화로 'completely wiped out'되는 것 = 멸종(become extinct)
❌ ② 크게 성공: 정반대 의미
❌ ③ 뒤섞여 하나가 됨: 문맥 무관
❌ ④ 수를 늘림: 멸종과 반대
det.tip: be wiped out = 전멸되다, 완전히 없어지다 (= become extinct)

det.analysis:

[조건] (1) human, if, nature, one, only, there, were 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '만약 단 하나의 인간 본성만 존재한다면' = if there were only one human nature.

questions.passage: A species with great variation will more likely have some survivors after any catastrophe ― the members who are well __________ (suit) for the new environment. Darwin observed variation in the bodies of animals, and the same principle applies to human minds.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 빈칸은 'the members who are well ___ (suit) for the new environment' 자리로, be동사(are) 뒤에서 '~된 상태'를 나타내야 하므로 과거분사 suited가 되어야 함.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'the members who are well ___ for the new environment(새 환경에 잘 ___한 구성원들)' 자리예요.

are(be동사) 뒤에 오므로 동사 suit를 그대로 쓰면 안 되고, '~된 상태'를 나타내는 과거분사 suited로 바꿔야 해요.

'be well suited for ~'는 '~에 잘 맞다, ~에 적합하다'라는 뜻의 표현이에요. 그래서 정답은 suited.
det.tip: be동사(are) + 과거분사(p.p.) = ~된 상태. suit → suited. well suited for = ~에 잘 맞는(적합한)
